coin.title: Official Restrike: Ducaton 2023 “Silver Rider” 1 Ounce – Royal Delft Edition
coin.description: Previous restrikes of the Ducaton were receive with great enthusiasm. Enough reason to release a restrike of this popular trade coin again for 2023! The former trade coin shows the “Silver Rider”, a rider on horseback with sword raised, ready for battle. This year, the popular coin will be available in silver, in both 1 ounce and 2 ounce. The Ducatons 2023 are strictly limited and come with a Certificate of Authenticity. Unique Royal Delft coin holder The Ducaton 2023 of the Royal Dutch Mint is, as always, presented in the traditional earthenware by Royal Delft. This year, the coin holder is completely about the Girl with a Pearl Earring, a painting by Johannes Vermeer. The Ducaton was also a means of payment in the time of Vermeer. In 2023, the Rijksmuseum will be dedicating an exhibition to the 17th-centry master for the first time in their history. Other museums also adapted their exhibitions to Johannes Vermeer. Also, a program can be watched on television, which will zoom in on some missing paintings by the artist. The Royal Dutch Mint also pays attention to this ‘Year of Johannes Vermeer’. The Ducaton 2023 will be released in a fitting coin holder. Specifications Royal Delft Coin Holder Size 110 mm diameter, 40 mm height Weight 280 g Material Earthenware Design High-quality transfer Year of issue 2023
